id     = "PROP"
name   = "SAT Layer"

[[option]]
  name       = "satSolver"
  category   = "expert"
  long       = "sat-solver=MODE"
  type       = "SatSolverMode"
  default    = "MINISAT"
  help       = "choose which sat solver to use, see --sat-solver=help"
  help_mode  = "CDCL(T) SAT solver backend."
[[option.mode.MINISAT]]
  name = "minisat"
[[option.mode.CADICAL]]
  name = "cadical"

[[option]]
  name       = "nodeDepth"
  category   = "common"
  long       = "expr-depth=N"
  type       = "int64_t"
  default    = "-1"
  minimum    = "-1"
  help       = "print exprs to depth N (0 == default, -1 == no limit)"

[[option]]
  name       = "dagThresh"
  category   = "common"
  long       = "dag-thresh=N"
  type       = "int64_t"
  default    = "1"
  minimum    = "0"
  help       = "dagify common subexprs appearing > N times (1 == default, 0 == don't dagify)"

help       = "print rationals and negative arithmetic literals as lexed tokens, e.g. 1/4, -1.5"

[[option]]
  name       = "printSkolemDefinitions"
  category   = "expert"
  long       = "print-skolem-definitions"
  type       = "bool"

category   = "common"
  long       = "tlimit=MS"
  type       = "uint64_t"
  default    = "0"
  help       = "set time limit in milliseconds of wall clock time"

[[option]]
  name       = "perCallMillisecondLimit"
  category   = "common"
  long       = "tlimit-per=MS"
  type       = "uint64_t"
  default    = "0"
  help       = "set time limit per query in milliseconds"

[[option]]
  name       = "cumulativeResourceLimit"
  category   = "common"
  long       = "rlimit=N"
  type       = "uint64_t"
  default    = "0"
  help       = "set resource limit"

[[option]]
  name       = "perCallResourceLimit"
  alias      = ["reproducible-resource-limit"]
  category   = "common"
  long       = "rlimit-per=N"
  type       = "uint64_t"
  default    = "0"
  help       = "set resource limit per query"
